wordProblems.q: A baker packs 4 boxes with 6 muffins in each box. Then she bakes 9 more muffins. How many muffins are there in all?
Sam has $44. Sam buys a toy for $18 and a book for $11. How many dollars does Sam have left?
Isabella has $32. Isabella earns $25 helping a neighbour, then spends $5 on lunch. How many dollars does Isabella have now?
A hall has 4 rows of chairs with 6 chairs in each row. The teacher adds 15 more chairs. How many chairs are there in all?
Grace collects 35 shells on Saturday and 26 shells on Sunday. Grace gives 29 shells to a friend. How many shells does Grace have left?
Jack has 6 buttons. Jack buys twice as many buttons as Jack already has, plus 18 more. How many buttons does Jack have now?
Ruby, Leo and Chloe each have 6 pencils. Their teacher gives them 4 more pencils to share. How many pencils do they have in all?
Lucas has 25 stickers. Lucas gives away 20 stickers, then buys 4 packs with the same number of stickers left in each pack. How many stickers does Lucas buy?
There are 35 red cars and 21 blue cars in a car park. 29 cars drive away. How many cars are left in the car park?
A ticket costs $5. Henry buys 7 tickets and a snack for $8. How many dollars does Henry spend in all?
Ava buys 5 packs of 8 pens and 4 packs of 8 pencils. How many pens and pencils does Ava buy in all?
65 children go on a school trip. 20 children ride in the first bus. The rest ride in the second bus. How many children ride in the second bus?
A baker makes 5 trays with 11 cookies on each tray. Her family eats 21 cookies. How many cookies are left?
Ruby plants 9 rows of carrots with 5 carrots in each row. Then Ruby plants 12 more carrots. How many carrots did Ruby plant in all?
Mia saves $7 every week for 4 weeks. Then Mia spends $22 on a game. How many dollars does Mia have left?
A library has 6 shelves with 8 books on each shelf. The librarian adds 12 more books. How many books are there in all?
A shop has 3 boxes with 10 apples in each box. The shop sells 12 apples. How many apples are left?
Lily has 49 red beads and 16 blue beads. Lily uses 36 beads to make a necklace. How many beads does Lily have left?
A cook has 7 cartons with 12 eggs in each carton. She uses 11 eggs to bake cakes. How many eggs are left?
Omar scores 40 points in the first game and 23 points in the second game. Omar gets 15 bonus points. How many points does Omar have in all?
Ella has $79. Ella buys a ball for $19 and a hat for $14. How many dollars does Ella have left?
Max fills 5 jars with 6 strawberries in each jar. Then Max picks 8 more strawberries. How many strawberries does Max have in all?
Sara saves $5 every week for 5 weeks. Then Sara buys a kite for $8 and a puzzle for $3. How many dollars does Sara have left?
A school has 5 classes with 7 children in each class. 9 new children join, and 26 children are away today. How many children are at school today?
Isabella has 19 ribbons. Her mum gives her twice as many ribbons as she already has, then Isabella gives 5 ribbons to a friend. How many ribbons does Isabella have now?
A shop has 6 crates with 8 bottles of juice in each crate. The shop sells 35 bottles. How many bottles are left?
Nora scores 33 points on Monday, 10 points on Tuesday and 15 points on Wednesday. How many points does Nora score in all?
Nora plants 9 rows of beans with 4 seeds in each row. 22 seeds grow into plants. How many seeds do not grow?
An adult ticket costs $11 and a child ticket costs $3. James buys 3 adult tickets and 4 child tickets. How many dollars does James spend in all?
Henry is reading a book with 80 pages. Henry reads 26 pages on Friday and 10 pages on Saturday. How many pages are left to read?
